scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@learntrack/api && npm run build --workspace=@learntrack/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@learntrack/api && npm run test --workspace=@learntrack/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@learntrack/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@learntrack/web
